desc:
🚗 ONE CAR. TWO PLAYERS. TOTAL CHAOS.

The party's over, it's getting late, and all you have to do is get home. Sounds easy? Think again.

🚘 DRIVER — Keep your eyes on the road, stay in control, avoid the cops, and get everyone home safely.

🤪 PASSENGER — Your job? Make the driver's life a nightmare! Mess with the car controls, cause distractions, and create as much chaos as possible.

🚔 Watch out for police patrols and unexpected encounters.
💨 Drift through city streets and winding forest roads.
👥 Play with a friend and see how long you can survive each other.
🏠 Reach home in one piece to win!

ONE DRIVES. ONE CAUSES PROBLEMS.

🎮 2-PLAYER CO-OP — Bring a friend!
⚠️ *BETA* — New features, improvements, and updates are on the way!

Can your friendship survive the ride home?
